content: Sɑnɑm mɛ Ɛsidɑrɑsi u yiire u kɑnɑru mɔ̀ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ u win tɔmbu suuru kɑnɑmmɛ, yerɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu kɑ bibu be kpuro bɑ mɑɑ sumɔ.
Yerɑ Sekɑniɑ Yehiɛlin bii Elɑmun debuminu sɔɔ, u Ɛsidɑrɑsi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡeemɑ, sɑ Gusunɔ torɑri ye sɑ kɑ tɔn tuko kurɔbu suɑ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ tem min tɔn kurɔbu. Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, Isirelibɑ bɑ yĩiyɔbu mɔ.
Tɛ̃, su kɑ Gusunɔ ɑrukɑwɑni bɔke kpɑ su tɔn tuko kurɔ be ɡirɑ kɑ bii be sɑ kɑ bu mɑrɑ nɡe mɛ Ɛsidɑrɑsi bɛsɛn yinni kɑ sere be bɑ woodɑ ye nɑsie bɑ ɡeruɑ. I de su ko nɡe mɛ Gusunɔn woodɑ ye, yɑ ɡeruɑ.
Wunɛ Ɛsidɑrɑsi, ɑ seewo, ɡɑri yi, yi nun wɑ. Sɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ wunɛn biruɔ. A de ɑ wɔruɡɔru ko kpɑ ɑ se ɑ ko nɡe mɛ.
Mɑ Ɛsidɑrɑsi u seewɑ u derɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ Lefibɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ bɔ̃ruɑ ɑrukɑwɑni yen sɔ̃.

Yen biru, Ɛsidɑrɑsi u yɑrɑ Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun di u dɑ Yokɑnɑni Eliɑsibun biin dirɔ. Sɑnɑm mɛ u duɑ mi, u ǹ dĩɑnu di, u ǹ mɑɑ nim nɔrɑ. Domi win nuki sɑnkire Isireli be bɑ yoru mwɛɛrɑn dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye bɑ kuɑn sɔ̃.
Mɑ bɑ kpɑrɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, Yudɑn tem kpuro sɔɔ ɡesi, be bɑ yoru mwɛɛrɑ kpuro bu mɛnnɑmɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Wi u yinɑ u nɑ sɔ̃ɔ itɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ, bɑ koo win ye u mɔ wɔrɑ kpɑ bu nùn yɑrɑ Isirelibɑn suunu sɔɔn di. Woodɑ yeniwɑ Isirelibɑn wiruɡibu kɑ ben bukurobu bɑ yi.
Mɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ sɔ̃ɔ itɑ yen bɑɑ sɔɔ wɔ̃ɔ ɡen suru nɔɔbɑ nnɛsen sɔ̃ɔ yɛnduse sɔɔrɑ mi. Tɔmbu kpuro bɑ mɛnnɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun yɑɑrɑ mi. Mɑ bɑ diirimɔ soku ten sɔ̃ kɑ ɡurɑn sɔ̃.

Yɑ̃ku kowo Ɛsidɑrɑsi u seewɑ u nɛɛ, wee i torɑ ye i kɑ tɔn tuko kurɔbu suɑ mɑ i Isirelibɑ kpuro doke tɑɑrɛ sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃ tɛ̃, i bɛɛn torɑnu tuubɑ koowo Gusunɔ bɛɛn bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinnin mi kpɑ i win kĩru ko.
I tii nɛnuɔ tem minin tɔmbun sɔ̃ kɑ sere mɑɑ ben kurɔbun sɔ̃.
Mɑ tɔn be kpuro bɑ wurɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ko ko nɡe mɛ ɑ ɡeruɑ.
Adɑmɑ tɔn be, bɑ dɑbi. Mɑ ɡurɑ nɛmɔ. Yen sɔ̃, bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu yɔ̃rɑ tɔɔwɔ. Yen biru, ɡɑri yi, yi ǹ sɔ̃ɔ teeru ǹ kun mɛ sɔ̃ɔ yirun sɔmburu. Domi tɔn dɑbirɑ tɑ torɑ ɡɑri yi sɔɔ.

Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, bɛsɛn wiruɡibu tɔnɑ bu sinɑ kpɑ be bɑ tɔn tuko kurɔbu sue bu nɑ kɑ ben ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ siri kowobu sɑɑ ye bɑ bu burɑ bu kɑ ɡɑri yi siri. Nɡe mɛyɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinnin mɔru yɑ koo kɑ doonɑ ɡɑri yin sɔ̃.
Yonɑtɑm, Asɑɛlin bii kɑ Yɑɑsiyɑ, Tikifɑn bii kɑ Mɛsulɑmu kɑ sere Sɑbetɑi Lefi wi, be tɔnɑwɑ bɑ ǹ kɑ sun nɔɔ tiɑ sɑ̃ɑ.

Adɑmɑ be bɑ tie bɑ wurɑmɑ yorun di bɑ ɡɑri yi wurɑ. Mɑ bɑ Ɛsidɑrɑsi yɑ̃ku kowo ɡɔsɑ kɑ sere yɛnu yɛ̃robu yɛnu bɑɑɡeren di ben bɑɑwure kɑ win yĩsiru. Mɑ bɑ ɡɑri yin siribu toruɑ wɔ̃ɔ ɡen suru wɔkurusen tɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikiru sɔɔ.
Wɔ̃ɔ kpɔɔn suru ɡbiikoon tɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikiru sɔɔrɑ bɑ be bɑ tɔn tuko kurɔbu suɑ siri bɑ kpɑ.
Yuu be bɑ torɑn yĩsɑ
Yɑ̃ku kowobu sɔɔ, ɡɑbɑ wɑ̃ɑ be bɑ tɔn tuko kurɔbu suɑ. Beyɑ Yosuen sikɑdominu kɑ win mɛro bisi Yosɑdɑkin bibu Mɑɑseyɑ kɑ Ɛliesɛɛ kɑ Yɑribu kɑ Gedɑliɑ.
Tɔn be, bɑ bɔ̃ruɑ bɑtumɑ sɔɔ bɑ nɛɛ, bɑ koo ben kurɔ be ɡirɑ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔn tukobu mi, kpɑ bu kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛru yɑ̃kuru ko ben torɑnun sɔ̃.
Imɛrin bweseru sɔɔ, Hɑnɑni kɑ Sebɑdiɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔɔ.
Hɑrimun bweseru sɔɔ, Mɑɑseyɑ kɑ Eli kɑ Semɑyɑ kɑ Yeyɛli kɑ Osiɑsi.
Pɑsurin bweseru sɔɔ, Elionɑi kɑ Mɑɑseyɑ kɑ Isimɛɛli kɑ Nɛtɑnɛɛli kɑ Yosɑbɑdi kɑ Eleɑsɑɑ.
Lefin bweseru sɔɔ, Yosɑbɑdi kɑ Simɛi kɑ Kelɑyɑ wi bɑ mɑɑ mɔ̀ Kelitɑ kɑ Petɑyɑ kɑ Yudɑ kɑ Ɛliesɛɛ.
Wom kowobun bweseru sɔɔ mɑɑ, Eliɑsibu. Sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔsun kɔ̃sobu sɔɔ, Sɑlumu kɑ Telɛmu kɑ Uri.
Isireli be bɑ tie sɔɔ, Pɑreɔsin bweseru sɔɔ Rɑmiɑ kɑ Yisiyɑ kɑ Mɑɑkiyɑ kɑ Miyɑmini kɑ Eleɑsɑɑ kɑ Mɑɑkiyɑ kɑ Bɛnɑyɑ.
Elɑmun bweseru sɔɔ, Mɑtɑniɑ kɑ Sɑkɑri kɑ Yehiɛli kɑ Abudi kɑ Yeremɔti kɑ Eli.
Sɑtun bweseru sɔɔ, Elionɑi kɑ Eliɑsibu kɑ Mɑtɑniɑ kɑ Yeremɔti kɑ Sɑbɑdi kɑ Asisɑ.
Bebɑin bweseru sɔɔ, Yokɑnɑni kɑ Hɑnɑniɑ kɑ Sɑbɑi kɑ Atilɑi.
Bɑnin bweseru sɔɔ, Mɛsulɑmu kɑ Mɑluku kɑ Adɑyɑ kɑ Yɑsubu kɑ Seɑli kɑ Yeremɔti.
Pɑkɑti Mɔɑbun bweseru sɔɔ, Adinɑ kɑ Kelɑli kɑ Bɛnɑyɑ kɑ Mɑɑseyɑ kɑ Mɑtɑniɑ kɑ Bɛsɑlɛli kɑ Binui kɑ Mɑnɑse.
Hɑrimun bweseru sɔɔ, Ɛliesɛɛ kɑ Yisiyɑ kɑ Mɑɑkiyɑ kɑ Semɑyɑ kɑ Simɛɔ
kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ kɑ Mɑluku kɑ Semɑriɑ.
Hɑsumun bweseru sɔɔ mɑɑ, Mɑtinɑi kɑ Mɑtɑtɑ kɑ Sɑbɑdi kɑ Elifelɛti kɑ Yeremɑi kɑ Mɑnɑse kɑ Simɛi.
Bɑnin bweseru sɔɔ, Mɑdɑi kɑ Amurɑmu kɑ Wɛli
kɑ Bɛnɑyɑ kɑ Bediɑ kɑ Keluhu
kɑ Fɑniɑ kɑ Mɛremɔtu kɑ Eliɑsibu
kɑ Mɑtɑniɑ kɑ Mɑtinɑi kɑ Yɑɑsɑi
kɑ Bɑni kɑ Binui kɑ Simɛi
kɑ Selemiɑ kɑ Nɑtɑni kɑ Adɑyɑ
kɑ Mɑkinɑbɑi kɑ Sɑsɑi kɑ Sɑrɑi
kɑ Asɑrɛli kɑ Selemiɑ kɑ Semɑriɑ
kɑ Sɑlumu kɑ Amɑriɑ kɑ Yosɛfu.
Nɛbon bweseru sɔɔ, Yeyɛli kɑ Mɑtitiɑ kɑ Sɑbɑdi kɑ Sebinɑ kɑ Yɑdɑi kɑ Yoɛli kɑ Bɛnɑyɑ.
Tɔn beni kpurowɑ bɑ tɔn tuko kurɔbu suɑ. Kurɔ ben ɡɑbɑ kɑ bu bibu mɑrɑ.
